reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.interpretation: Documented influence, declared origin, analytical compatibility and unresolved transmission are separate. Native diagrams/tables are preserved; these edges constrain how they may be read.
